title: Prenuvo header
description: A sticky night bar that starts transparent over the hero and fills with deep teal once you scroll. Thin lowercase wordmark, a row of quiet semibold links, a gradient Book pill and a region picker on desktop; a three-line menu, the wordmark and a smaller pill on phones.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); it overlaps the block below by its own height, so put a full-bleed hero next
the teal fill fades in over the first 400px of page scroll (CSS scroll timeline); without support, or with reduced motion, the fill is always on
menu and region picker are <details> disclosures: no JavaScript
